title: Build a Mini Eval to Test Your AI Prompt
description:
Does your prompt actually work? Test it! 🧪

✅ List a few test cases
✅ Ask the model each one and count the right answers
✅ Tighten the prompt until the score goes up

Day 8 of Spec-Driven AI! Next up, Day 9: Gate Spec Changes with a CI Eval.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

comment: Cases first or prompt first: which do you write? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: rerun the eval after every prompt change, so you see right away if the score drops.
